EmailTemplate.subject: Transition to Service for Asset {!pse__Proj__c.NSP_RET_Client_ID__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi CLIENT CONTACT, I want to take a moment to thank you for the opportunity to serve as your Insperity Onboarding Specialist. I know the transition process can feel overwhelming at times and I hope we have made you feel at ease throughout. In order to make sure we are providing the highest level of service possible, we will be sending you a brief survey and I would love to hear your feedback.
Now that your transition is complete, your dedicated Insperity Client Liaison/HR Specialist is ready to serve as your main point of contact and will reach out to schedule a welcome and introduction call. If you need assistance sooner or have any questions, outside of payroll, please direct them to:
Insperity Client Liaison CL NAME CL EMAIL Insperity HR Specialist HRS NAME HRS EMAIL
Once again, it has been a pleasure to serve you and I wish you all the best! Warmest Regards, Signature
